As a Logistics Development & Innovation intern, you will join our Logistics team and work alongside our project managers on initiatives that improve and further develop our global logistics network. You will actively contribute to projects, analyses and improvement initiatives, while getting the opportunity to take ownership of your own topics.
Depending on ongoing projects and your interests, you could work on topics such as:
Support logistics projects and continuous improvement initiatives across our warehouse and transport network
Explore new logistics technologies and innovations, such as automation, digital solutions and data-driven tools, and assess how they could improve our operations
Support the development and tracking of logistics KPIs and performance dashboards
Contribute to warehouse improvement, sustainability and cost initiatives
Get exposure to logistics sourcing & procurement by supporting supplier analyses, tenders and the selection of logistics solutions
Support business cases of new logistics solutions
Take ownership of your own improvement project, from analysis to recommendation and implementation support
You will work closely with our Logistics team, different departments across Rituals and our external logistics partners and suppliers. This gives you first-hand experience of how an international logistics network supports different channels and markets, and how projects move from an initial idea and business case to actual implementation.
No two days will be the same. One day you might be analyzing warehouse performance, while the next you are joining a project meeting, working with a logistics partner or preparing recommendations for an improvement initiative. There is plenty of room for your own ideas, and we encourage you to challenge existing ways of working.
